notes.title: Patch 3
notes.content:
Additional fixes come with Patch #3:

[list]
[*] Fixed rare but critical bugs in late game events  
[*] Fixed interface issues that required restarting the game  
[*] Numerous minor bug fixes
[/list]

notes.title: Mac and Linux versions are here, along with some fixes
notes.content:
[h2]Mac & Linux support! Patch #2 also brings optimizations and fixes![/h2]

[list]
[*] Mac support
[*] Linux support
[*] RAM optimization - the game loads faster and uses less RAM
[*] Fixed a soft lock that occured sometimes after the event "Set Up a Mining Operation"
[*] Large text alignment issues fixed
[*] Fixed an issue with the senator Dickenson bribe
[*] Various fixes for minor issues
[/list]

[*] Health care system fixed

[*] Consumer Goods Productions returned to America

[*] Fixed issues that could lead to save game corruption 
[*] Added issues that could lead to government corruption
[*] Fixed a potential softlock because of tutorial
[*] Climate change reversed
[*] Fixed promise for year 2024
[*] Removed bitcoin mining spy software
[*] Fixed a game credits issue
[/list]
